instruction.name: vmskltz.w
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, for each 32-bit element in `a`, set the bit at that element's index within the lane to one if the element is less than zero, otherwise zero; the remaining bits of the lane are zero.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vmskltz.w $vr0, $vr8; vmskltz.w $vr1, $vr9; vmskltz.w $vr2, $vr10; vmskltz.w $vr3, $vr11; vmskltz.w $vr4, $vr12; vmskltz.w $vr5, $vr13; vmskltz.w $vr6, $vr14; vmskltz.w $vr7, $vr15
